unit.title: Was that a compliment or a joke?
canDo: Interpret a teasing line using timing and shared facts
Recognise conversational emphasis without assigning it one fixed emotion
Change a reply to fit a new acquaintance rather than a close friend

grammar.explanation: 可真 strengthens the following evaluation. It does not encode teasing by itself: timing, known facts and the relationship may make a literal compliment ironic.

examples.py: nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo .
zhè lǐ kě zhēn ān jìng .

commonMistakes.wrong: 只要说可真，就一定是在讽刺。
commonMistakes.right: 可真加强语气，意思还要看场景。
commonMistakes.why: The same emphasis can be sincere or ironic; the scene supplies the interpretation.

grammar.explanation: 怪 before an adjective with 的 often means quite or rather in casual speech. This use differs from 怪不得 and the adjective 奇怪.

examples.py: zhè jiàn wài tào guài hǎo kàn de .

commonMistakes.why: Place 怪 before the adjective and 的 after it.

grammar.pattern: 才不 / 才不要 + 呢
grammar.purpose: Reject an idea emphatically in casual speech
grammar.explanation: 才 before a negative can make a denial sound stronger and playful or defensive. It is not the time-marker meaning “only then”.

examples.py: wǒ cái bú yào zhè gè jiǎng ne .
wǒ cái bù huì wàng ne .

commonMistakes.wrong: 我才不要这个奖呢，意思是我等到明天才要。
commonMistakes.right: 我才不要这个奖呢，意思是我不想要。
commonMistakes.why: This 才 strengthens the refusal rather than scheduling it.

grammar.purpose: Point out a missing condition conversationally
grammar.explanation: A negative completed-state phrase sets up the rhetorical question: without the earlier event, how can the next action happen? A genuine request for a method can have the same words, so inspect the reply.

examples.py: hái méi chī zěn me kuā wèi dào ?
examples.en: How can I praise the taste before eating?

examples.zh: 还没看完，怎么知道最后发生什么？
examples.py: hái méi kàn wán , zěn me zhī dào zuì hòu fā shēng shén me ?
examples.en: How can I know the ending before finishing?

commonMistakes.wrong: 还没吃怎么夸味道，所以我已经吃了。
commonMistakes.right: 还没吃怎么夸味道？先让我尝一个。
commonMistakes.why: The speaker is asking to try it before assessing its taste.

dialogue.title: 你今天可真早
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你今天可真早。
lines.py: nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo .
lines.en: You’re really early today, aren’t you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 早？我不是晚了十分钟吗？
lines.py: zǎo ? wǒ bù shì wǎn le shí fēn zhōng ma ?
lines.en: Early? Aren’t I ten minutes late?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，我的咖啡都快喝完了。
lines.py: duì , wǒ de kā fēi dōu kuài hē wán le .
lines.en: Exactly. I’ve almost finished my coffee.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 懂了，你在笑我。对不起，刚才走错出口了。
lines.py: dǒng le , nǐ zài xiào wǒ . duì bù qǐ , gāng cái zǒu cuò chū kǒu le .
lines.en: Got it. You’re teasing me. Sorry, I took the wrong exit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先坐吧。怎么穿这么正式？你等会儿还要去开会？
lines.py: xiān zuò ba . zěn me chuān zhè me zhèng shì ? nǐ děng huì ér hái yào qù kāi huì ?
lines.en: Sit down first. Why so formal? Do you have a meeting later?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，今天第一次穿这件外套。不好看吗？
lines.py: méi yǒu , jīn tiān dì yī cì chuān zhè jiàn wài tào . bù hǎo kàn ma ?
lines.en: No, it’s my first time wearing this coat. Doesn’t it look good?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怪好看的。我刚才还以为你要去领奖。
lines.py: guài hǎo kàn de . wǒ gāng cái hái yǐ wéi nǐ yào qù lǐng jiǎng .
lines.en: It looks pretty good. I thought you were going to collect an award.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你快给我颁一个，别只有咖啡。
lines.py: nà nǐ kuài gěi wǒ bān yī gè , bié zhǐ yǒu kā fēi .
lines.en: Then hurry up and give me one instead of just coffee.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 给你一个“终于找到出口”的奖，行不行？
lines.py: gěi nǐ yī gè zhōng yú zhǎo dào chū kǒu de jiǎng , xíng bù xíng ?
lines.en: An award for “finally finding the exit”—will that do?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 才不要呢。你上次还让我去错了车站。
lines.py: cái bú yào ne . nǐ shàng cì hái ràng wǒ qù cuò le chē zhàn .
lines.en: No thanks. You sent me to the wrong station last time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好好好，这个话题跳过。想吃什么？
lines.py: hǎo hǎo hǎo , zhè gè huà tí tiào guò . xiǎng chī shén me ?
lines.en: All right, all right, let’s skip that topic. What would you like to eat?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先来点甜的。听你说完，我现在需要点安慰。
lines.py: xiān lái diǎn tián de . tīng nǐ shuō wán , wǒ xiàn zài xū yào diǎn ān wèi .
lines.en: Something sweet first. After hearing you out, I could use some comfort.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why does “you are early” sound teasing here?
choices: The listener is ten minutes late
The café has not opened yet
The listener arrived before the agreed time
questions.answer: The listener is ten minutes late

choices: Taking the wrong exit
Receiving an actual award
Finishing all the coffee first

questions.q: Is the coat comment also simply a negative criticism?
choices: No, the speaker says it looks quite good and jokes about an award
Yes, every joke must reject the coat
No comment about the coat is made
questions.answer: No, the speaker says it looks quite good and jokes about an award

reading.title: 你今天可真早
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 我第一次听到“你今天可真早”，是在迟到十分钟以后。按字面看，朋友像是在夸我；看他已经喝完半杯咖啡的样子，就知道不是这个意思。
lines.py: wǒ dì yī cì tīng dào nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo , shì zài chí dào shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu . àn zì miàn kàn , péng you xiàng shì zài kuā wǒ ; kàn tā yǐ jīng hē wán bàn bēi kā fēi de yàng zi , jiù zhī dào bù shì zhè gè yì si .
lines.en: The first time I heard “you’re really early today” was after arriving ten minutes late. Literally it sounded like praise, but seeing my friend with half his coffee gone made the intention clear.

lines.zh: 那天我们笑了几句，很快开始点吃的。我认识他很久，知道他会拿我的迟到开玩笑，也知道说一句对不起就能把事情接过去。
lines.py: nà tiān wǒ men xiào le jǐ jù , hěn kuài kāi shǐ diǎn chī de . wǒ rèn shi tā hěn jiǔ , zhī dào tā huì ná wǒ de chí dào kāi wán xiào , yě zhī dào shuō yī jù duì bù qǐ jiù néng bǎ shì qíng jiē guò qù .
lines.en: We joked briefly and soon started ordering food. I’d known him a long time and knew he teased me about lateness; a quick apology let us move on.

lines.zh: 后来我在活动里看到一个新同学迟到，差点也说同样的话。她进门时很紧张，一直解释公交车改了路线。我最后只说“没关系，先坐吧”，没有照搬朋友的说法。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ zài huó dòng lǐ kàn dào yī gè xīn tóng xué chí dào , chà diǎn yě shuō tóng yàng de huà . tā jìn mén shí hěn jǐn zhāng , yì zhí jiě shì gōng jiāo chē gǎi le lù xiàn . wǒ zuì hòu zhǐ shuō méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , méi yǒu zhào bān péng you de shuō fǎ .
lines.en: Later, at an event, a new classmate arrived late and I almost used the same phrase. She was nervous and kept explaining that her bus route had changed. I just said, “It’s okay, sit down,” rather than copying my friend’s line.

lines.zh: 活动结束后，她问我刚才是不是错过了重要内容。我把前面的安排说给她听，我们后来聊了喜欢的音乐。熟悉以后，也会开玩笑，但不是一开始就拿她着急的事来笑。
lines.py: huó dòng jié shù hòu , tā wèn wǒ gāng cái shì bú shì cuò guò le zhòng yào nèi róng . wǒ bǎ qián miàn de ān pái shuō gěi tā tīng , wǒ men hòu lái liáo le xǐ huān de yīn yuè . shú xī yǐ hòu , yě huì kāi wán xiào , dàn bù shì yī kāi shǐ jiù ná tā zháo jí de shì lái xiào .
lines.en: Afterwards she asked whether she’d missed anything important. I explained the plans, and we later talked about music we liked. Once we knew each other we joked too, but I didn’t start by teasing her about something that was worrying her.

lines.zh: 我给自己记下的不是一句固定的“友好表达”，而是三个问题：刚才发生了什么？两个人熟不熟？对方现在什么表情？同样一句话，答案变了，听起来也会变。
lines.py: wǒ gěi zì jǐ jì xià de bù shì yī jù gù dìng de yǒu hǎo biǎo dá , ér shì sān gè wèn tí : gāng cái fā shēng le shén me ? liǎng gè rén shú bù shú ? duì fāng xiàn zài shén me biǎo qíng ? tóng yàng yī jù huà , dá àn biàn le , tīng qǐ lái yě huì biàn .
lines.en: I didn’t note a fixed “friendly phrase,” but three questions: what just happened, how well do the people know each other, and what expression does the other person have? When those answers change, the same sentence can sound different.

lines.zh: 现在看剧时，我会留意说话前后发生的事。人物说“真不错”，可能是真心称赞，也可能是对刚发生的问题作出反应。我先找线索，不只找一个词的翻译。
lines.py: xiàn zài kàn jù shí , wǒ huì liú yì shuō huà qián hòu fā shēng de shì . rén wù shuō zhēn bù cuò , kě néng shì zhēn xīn chēng zàn , yě kě néng shì duì gāng fā shēng de wèn tí zuò chū fǎn yìng . wǒ xiān zhǎo xiàn suǒ , bù zhǐ zhǎo yī gè cí de fān yì .
lines.en: Now when watching dramas I notice what happens before and after a line. “Really good” may be sincere praise or a reaction to a problem. I look for clues rather than just the translation of one word.

choices: A familiar phrase needs situational and relationship context
可真 always expresses anger
Literal translation alone settles every intention
questions.answer: A familiar phrase needs situational and relationship context

questions.q: What reply is given to the new classmate?
choices: 没关系，先坐吧
你可真早
你一定在骗我

questions.q: Why avoid the old teasing line with the new classmate?
choices: She is anxious and they do not yet know each other well
The old line has no valid grammar
The classmate arrived a day early
questions.answer: She is anxious and they do not yet know each other well

extraReadings.title: Eat attentively
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你做的？看着还真不错。
lines.py: nǐ zuò de ? kàn zhe hái zhēn bù cuò .
lines.en: Did you make this? It really looks good.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 当然。我试了三次才做好。
lines.py: dāng rán . wǒ shì le sān cì cái zuò hǎo .
lines.en: Of course. It took three attempts to get it right.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我可以吃一个吗？
lines.py: nà wǒ kě yǐ chī yī gè ma ?
lines.en: May I have one?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先等一下，你还没夸味道呢。
lines.py: xiān děng yī xià , nǐ hái méi kuā wèi dào ne .
lines.en: Wait a moment. You haven’t praised the taste yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还没吃怎么夸？
lines.py: hái méi chī zěn me kuā ?
lines.en: How can I praise it before eating?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 也是。吃完再说，别只说“不难吃”。
lines.py: yě shì . chī wán zài shuō , bié zhǐ shuō bù nán chī .
lines.en: True. Tell me after trying it, and don’t just say “not bad.”
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要求还挺高。好，我认真吃。
lines.py: yāo qiú hái tǐng gāo . hǎo , wǒ rèn zhēn chī .
lines.en: Your standards are pretty high. Okay, I’ll eat attentively.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 认真吃是什么样？慢一点还是多一点？
lines.py: rèn zhēn chī shì shén me yàng ? màn yī diǎn hái shi duō yī diǎn ?
lines.en: What does eating attentively look like—slower, or more?
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: How many attempts did the maker need?
choices: Three
One
Ten

questions.q: Why can the friend not praise the taste yet?
choices: They have not tried the food
The maker has never cooked
The food has already all been eaten
questions.answer: They have not tried the food

lines.zh: 别看不起这个小店，做的东西很认真。
lines.py: bié kàn bù qǐ zhè gè xiǎo diàn , zuò de dōng xi hěn rèn zhēn .
lines.en: Don’t underestimate this small shop; it makes things carefully.

lines.zh: 准备以后，我比刚才自信多了。
lines.py: zhǔn bèi yǐ hòu , wǒ bǐ gāng cái zì xìn duō le .
lines.en: After preparing I’m much more confident than before.

lines.zh: 她有自信，也愿意听不同意见。
lines.py: tā yǒu zì xìn , yě yuàn yì tīng bù tóng yì jiàn .
lines.en: She’s confident and willing to hear different views.

lines.zh: 他们从小一起长大，关系很亲密。
lines.py: tā men cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà , guān xì hěn qīn mì .
lines.en: They grew up together and are very close.

lines.zh: 只有亲密的朋友知道这个小名。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu qīn mì de péng you zhī dào zhè gè xiǎo míng .
lines.en: Only close friends know this childhood nickname.

lines.zh: 这句语法没错，但不适合这个场合。
lines.py: zhè jù yǔ fǎ méi cuò , dàn bù shì hé zhè gè chǎng hé .
lines.en: The grammar is correct, but it doesn’t fit this situation.

lines.zh: 我想问问这两个语法结构有什么不同。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn wèn zhè liǎng gè yǔ fǎ jié gòu yǒu shén me bù tóng .
lines.en: I’d like to ask how these two grammatical structures differ.

lines.zh: 这次课先练语音，再练对话。
lines.py: zhè cì kè xiān liàn yǔ yīn , zài liàn duì huà .
lines.en: This class practises speech sounds before dialogue.

lines.zh: 她给我发了一条语音，让我听听语气。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ fā le yī tiáo yǔ yīn , ràng wǒ tīng tīng yǔ qì .
lines.en: She sent me a voice message so I could hear the delivery.

lines.zh: 你会怎么形容这个人的表情？
lines.py: nǐ huì zěn me xíng róng zhè gè rén de biǎo qíng ?
lines.en: How would you describe this person’s expression?

lines.zh: 我找不到合适的词来形容那个声音。
lines.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào hé shì de cí lái xíng róng nà gè shēng yīn .
lines.en: I can’t find the right word to describe that sound.

lines.zh: 我把他的玩笑当真，误会了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ tā de wán xiào dàng zhēn , wù huì le .
lines.en: I took his joke seriously and misunderstood.

lines.zh: 别误会，我不是说你做得不好。
lines.py: bié wù huì , wǒ bù shì shuō nǐ zuò de bù hǎo .
lines.en: Don’t misunderstand; I’m not saying you did a bad job.

lines.zh: 这个话题我们上次聊过。
lines.py: zhè gè huà tí wǒ men shàng cì liáo guò .
lines.en: We talked about this topic last time.

lines.zh: 大家都安静了，我换了个话题。
lines.py: dà jiā dōu ān jìng le , wǒ huàn le gè huà tí .
lines.en: Everyone went quiet, so I changed the topic.

lines.zh: 他们关系很好，但意见不总一样。
lines.py: tā men guān xì hěn hǎo , dàn yì jiàn bù zǒng yī yàng .
lines.en: They have a good relationship but don’t always agree.

lines.zh: 这件事和钱没关系。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì hé qián méi guān xì .
lines.en: This has nothing to do with money.

lines.zh: 他说话时表情很认真。
lines.py: tā shuō huà shí biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn .
lines.en: His expression was serious as he spoke.

lines.zh: 看到盒子里的东西，她的表情变了。
lines.py: kàn dào hé zi lǐ de dōng xi , tā de biǎo qíng biàn le .
lines.en: Her expression changed when she saw what was in the box.

lines.zh: 先坐一会儿，放松一下。
lines.py: xiān zuò yī huì er , fàng sōng yī xià .
lines.en: Sit for a while and relax.

lines.zh: 放松以后，我说话没那么快了。
lines.py: fàng sōng yǐ hòu , wǒ shuō huà méi nà me kuài le .
lines.en: After relaxing I didn’t speak so fast.

pragmatics.situation: Repair a joke that lands badly

natural.zh: 我刚才开玩笑的，不过那句说得不合适。
natural.py: wǒ gāng cái kāi wán xiào de , bù guò nà jù shuō de bù hé shì .
natural.en: I was joking, but that line was not well chosen.

pragmatics.note: Acknowledge your wording instead of claiming the other person must enjoy it.

natural.zh: 没关系，先坐吧，我告诉你刚才说到哪儿。
natural.py: méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , wǒ gào sù nǐ gāng cái shuō dào nǎr .
natural.en: It is okay; sit down and I will tell you where we got to.

pragmatics.note: This responds to the actual missed information rather than copying close-friend banter.

audio.zh: 早？我不是晚了十分钟吗？
audio.py: zǎo ? wǒ bù shì wǎn le shí fēn zhōng ma ?
audio.en: Early? Aren’t I ten minutes late?

tasks.statement: The person arrived ten minutes before the meeting.
tasks.why: They explicitly say they are ten minutes late.

audio.zh: 后来我在活动里看到一个新同学迟到，差点也说同样的话。她进门时很紧张，一直解释公交车改了路线。我最后只说“没关系，先坐吧”，没有照搬朋友的说法。
audio.py: hòu lái wǒ zài huó dòng lǐ kàn dào yī gè xīn tóng xué chí dào , chà diǎn yě shuō tóng yàng de huà . tā jìn mén shí hěn jǐn zhāng , yì zhí jiě shì gōng jiāo chē gǎi le lù xiàn . wǒ zuì hòu zhǐ shuō méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , méi yǒu zhào bān péng you de shuō fǎ .
audio.en: Later, at an event, a new classmate arrived late and I almost used the same phrase. She was nervous and kept explaining that her bus route had changed. I just said, “It’s okay, sit down,” rather than copying my friend’s line.

tasks.statement: The narrator repeats the same teasing line to the new classmate.
tasks.why: They choose 没关系，先坐吧 instead.

prompt.py: hái méi chī zěn me kuā ?
prompt.en: How can I praise it without trying it?

choices: 也是，你先尝一个。
对，你已经吃了十个。
不用尝，没吃过也已经知道味道。
tasks.why: The reply accepts that tasting comes before judging.

prompt.py: zhè jù yí dìng shì zài shēng qì ma ?
prompt.en: Does this line definitely show anger?

choices: 不一定，要看前后发生了什么。
对，只要有可真就生气。
只要有可真就一定在夸，从来不会生气。
tasks.answer: 不一定，要看前后发生了什么。
tasks.why: The wording alone does not establish the emotion.
